==Summary==

{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}

The dice Mat hears sometimes just started up again and [[Egeanin]] wants to settle the issue of who's in command. Mat doesn't believe there is anything to settle and tells her he is off to see [[Tuon]]. Egeanin is affronted that Mat uses Tuon's name but Mat just grins. [[Luca]]'s show is preparing to leave Ebou Dar so everyone else is busy getting ready. Still, Mat is apprehensive about seeing Tuon for the first time since he kidnapped her and called her his wife. He finally goes inside the wagon shared by Tuon, her maid, [[Selucia]], and the former innkeeper, [[Setalle Anan]]. Tuon calls Mat 'Toy' which he dislikes, but can't get her to stop. Tuon though is very unhappy to be labeled a servant and even more a faithless thieving servant. Mat promises to get Tuon back home as soon as he can, but not until everyone is safe and she will just have to put up with being viewed as a servant. Mat asks her age, and she figures she will be twenty in a month, but is offended again that Mat might have thought her a child.

Tuon asks Mat if he remembers Hawkwing's face, which freezes him while memories of [[Culain]] fighting and losing to Hawkwing come to the surface. Tuon then promises to not try to escape or betray him in any way. Mat spits on his hand to seal the bargain and she asks about the writing on his spear, 'Thus is our treaty written; thus is agreement made.' Just as their hands touch sealing their agreement, the dice stop in his head. Thom enters the wagon to let Mat know that Tuon's disappearance isn't public knowledge. He also tells Mat that Tylin is dead, killed in her bedroom by the ''gholam'', although the [[Seanchan]] have publicly laid blame on the [[Aes Sedai]]. Tuon tells Mat that he shouldn't believe in myths and reprimands him with a rap on his head. 

[[Blaeric]] enters to tell Mat that [[Joline]] wants to see him, with no delay. Mat enters the wagon Joline shares with [[Edesina Azzedin]], [[Teslyn Baradon]] and the three ''sul'dam'' [[Bethamin]], [[Seta]] and [[Renna]]. Mat exclaims Tylin was murdered but Joline ignores this and insists the show should head toward Illian instead of Lugard. Teslyn immediately objects and argues with Joline. Renna interrupts by suggesting they should be [[A'dam|collared]] in order to teach them to behave. Mat ends the argument and after being pressed by him, the Aes Sedai all say there is channeling to the far north, a vast amount of channeling and they should go as far from it as possible. Mat sees a rainbow of colors that almost coalesces into an image of a man and woman sitting near each other, which he is sure is Rand.
